Nigeria Tax Reform Acts 2025 · 7-Level Progressive Education Game

📖 HOW TO PLAY — TAXNOMICS ARENA™

🎯 Objective

Navigate Nigeria's 2025 Tax Reforms across 7 progressive levels. Roll the 8-sided die, land on a Tax Zone, answer questions from the 4 Nigeria Tax Acts 2025. Highest Compliance Score wins!

🎲 The Die → Zone (1–8)

  • 1 → 💚 Income Tax (Nigeria Tax Act Ch.2)
  • 2 → 🔵 VAT (Nigeria Tax Act Ch.6)
  • 3 → 💰 Capital Gains (Nigeria Tax Act Ch.2 Pt.VIII)
  • 4 → 🏛️ Tax Administration (Tax Admin Act 2025)
  • 5 → ⛽ Petroleum Tax (Nigeria Tax Act Ch.3)
  • 6 → 📜 Stamp Duty (Nigeria Tax Act Ch.5)
  • 7 → ⚠️ PENALTY ZONE (−20 pts automatic)
  • 8 → ⭐ BONUS ZONE (+25 pts automatic)

📈 7 Levels — Continuous Play

  • Select your starting level. Game is CONTINUOUS — it never stops between levels!
  • Earn XP by answering correctly. When XP reaches threshold, a Level Up banner appears.
  • Click Level Up to advance mid-game and earn +30 bonus points.
  • Questions get more technical, complex and high-value as levels increase.

📊 Scoring

  • L1–2: ±10–15 pts · L3–4: ±20–28 pts · L5–6: ±35–42 pts · L7: ±50 pts
  • Bonus Zone: +25 pts · Penalty Zone: −20 pts · Level Up Bonus: +30 pts

💾 Player Names

Your entered names are saved automatically. Use the "Load Saved" button to recall previous players. Names persist between sessions.
